data.long_meaning: In Islamic history, Daeb is mentioned as a companion of Prophet Solomon (as). He was a powerful jinn who helped Solomon in his battles and ruled over mountains. This name symbolizes strength, power, and loyalty. The name Daeb carries the meaning “The Crushing One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. in_urdu.name: داہب
